title: The Black Wings of Icarus
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran) omitted by convention even though Ran is the key witness who accompanies Arimori to the plateau all day and sees the butterfly land on his shoulder -- her testimony is represented indirectly through the edges it establishes (e.g. o8 lands_on p1, p1 was_at l4). The old lower-fidelity case file (cases/ep203-204_the_black_wings_of_icarus.json) had the correct culprit (Mitsuyuki Arimori/s1) and correct broad trick (hang glider + pollen/scale evidence), confirmed against the full transcript, so label.murderer_id is unchanged. However it was thin: it collapsed the whole crime into 2 generic murder events, omitted Arimori's true motive entirely (his late brother Teruhiko, never mentioned in the old file), omitted the two red-herring suspects' motives (Shiromoto's divorce/debt dispute, Miyabe's forced recast of Chizuru), omitted the locked-room staging mechanics (door guard removed/reinstalled with a screwdriver, no footprints on the stool table), omitted the unwitting-accomplice trick (hiding in Shinobu's car trunk to get back to the plateau undetected, since flying a hang glider back uphill is aerodynamically impossible per Kogoro), and mislabeled the culprit's stun-gun+rope as generic 'was_used_in' rather than direct honest verbs. Character-card romanization 'Shimokasa' (not the old file's 'Shimogasa') and 'Kouichi Mito' are used here as the higher-fidelity source. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: A Miyama white butterfly (o8), a species found only atop the plateau, landed on Arimori's shoulder in front of witnesses during the day and died there; a matching wing scale (o7) was later found on Chizuru's skirt -- proving Arimori had personally carried her body while he still had that scale on him, even though everyone believed Chizuru had never left the hotel.

Chizuru's feet were bare, yet no footprints were found on the table (o6) pushed beneath the window that she supposedly stood on and kicked away to hang herself -- proves she never climbed it herself, meaning the hanging was staged after death rather than a suicide.
